Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.


THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to define and lead the technical direction of our platform as we scale 10x+ in enterprise customers.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role responsible for architecture, reliability, and developer experience across our Kubernetes-based infrastructure. You will solve hard technical problems, raise the engineering bar through your work, and be a key technical partner to product engineers across the company.

 


WHAT YOU WILL OWN


PLATFORM RELIABILITY & SCALABILITY

 - Design and implement scalable solutions within our Kubernetes-based platform for secure enterprise workloads.

 - Define and contribute to reliability initiatives: SLOs, capacity planning, and resilience improvements.

 - Identify and resolve system misconfigurations and architectural risks.

 - Build systems that support 10x customer growth with clear failure modes and mitigation strategies.


INFRASTRUCTURE AS A PRODUCT

 - Own and continuously improve internal platform systems: deployments, environments, and developer tooling.

 - Drive improvements to reliability, observability, and operational workflows.

 - Act as a force multiplier for product engineers by building guardrails (not gates) and self-serve tooling.


SYSTEMS THINKING

 - Bring structure and rigor to complex infrastructure problems.

 - Contribute to internal engineering standards and design principles.

 - Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and leadership to unblock and accelerate delivery.


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - Extensive, production-grade Kubernetes scaling experience
    (not just operating clusters, but growing them significantly from early-stage to production-critical workloads).

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems tradeoffs.

 - Previously worked in:
   
   - Big tech → then startup
   
   - Or startup that successfully scaled infrastructure.

 - Strong systems mindset.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity.

 - Enjoys being a technical owner with broad company impact.

Bonus

 - Experience with single-tenant architectures.

 - Background in financial services or regulated environments.

 - Familiarity with banking-level security and data governance.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup. 

 - You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible. 

 - You are curious.  You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

 - You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

 - You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.


WHY JOIN ROGO?

 - Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous.

 - Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance.

 - A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale.

 - Real ownership: You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work.

 - Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening.

Software Engineer – 2026 AfroTech Attendees
PLEASE NOTE
This opportunity is reserved for registered 2026 AfroTech attendees as part of Axon’s AfroTech recruiting experience. You must be attending AfroTech 2026 to apply through this posting.
Not attending AfroTech this year? We still want to hear from you. Explore current opportunities and find your place at Axon at axon.com/careers .
Work Location
These opportunities may be based out of our  Boston, Scottsdale, or Seattle offices.
We follow a hybrid schedule and rely on in-person collaboration. Team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays , with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Join Axon and Be a Force for Good
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities, and each other.
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging, and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. You’ll constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters and a company where you matter.
Your Impact
As a Software Engineer at Axon, you’ll help build technology that supports mission-critical products used by customers around the world.
We are hiring engineers across a range of experience levels. Depending on your background, you may be growing your skills alongside experienced engineers, independently owning features and services, or leading technical design and architecture for complex systems.
You’ll work in a collaborative, AI-first engineering environment where modern development tools, automation, and AI-assisted workflows are part of how we build software. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and other teams to solve meaningful customer problems while building reliable, scalable technology.
Whether you are early in your career or an experienced engineer, we are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, care about quality, and want to continue growing.
What You’ll Do
Depending on your experience and the team you join, you may:
Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production software and services
Own features and technical projects from requirements through production
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture design
Build highly available, scalable, and performant systems for mission-critical products
Work with modern cloud, distributed systems, data, and open-source technologies
Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to build solutions that solve real customer problems
Use AI-assisted development tools, automation, and intelligent workflows to improve engineering productivity and software quality
Validate and critically evaluate AI-generated code and technical recommendations
Improve testing, observability, reliability, and operational efficiency
Contribute to engineering processes and technical best practices
Learn from experienced engineers and share your knowledge with others
At more senior levels, provide technical leadership, influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and help raise the technical bar across teams
What You Bring
We know great engineers come from many different backgrounds. Relevant experience may come from professional roles, internships, academic work, military experience, open-source contributions, boot camps, or other hands-on software development.
We’re interested in candidates who bring some combination of:
A foundation in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience programming in languages such as Java, Go, Scala, C#, Python, C++, or similar
Experience or interest in building backend services, APIs, cloud applications, distributed systems, or other production software
Familiarity with SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
An understanding of software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and system design appropriate to your experience level
Curiosity about modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development, code generation, and automation
A commitment to writing reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
A desire to understand customer problems and build technology that makes a meaningful impact
For more experienced engineers, we may also look for:
Experience designing and delivering highly available, scalable cloud-based systems
Ownership of production services and complex technical projects
Strong system design and architecture experience
Experience making and communicating engineering tradeoffs
Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction
Experience improving developer workflows through automation or AI-assisted engineering practices
Benefits That Benefit You
Competitive salary and 401(k) with employer match
Discretionary paid time off
Paid parental leave for all
Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
Fitness programs
Emotional & Mental Wellness support
Learning & Development programs
And yes, we have snacks in our offices
Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.
Don’t meet every single requirement? That’s ok.
At Axon, we Aim Far . We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
